body: Create a square reaction meme with two vertically stacked panels and expressive editorial illustration. Keep the reference person recognizable in both panels. Preserve their facial features, skin tone and hairstyle. In the top panel, show them smiling enthusiastically at their phone in daylight; caption "Me making plans". In the bottom panel, show them wrapped in a blanket on the sofa at night, reluctantly looking toward shoes by the door; caption "Me when it's time to leave". Put each caption in a generous clear band inside its own panel, using large bold English lettering. No additional text, logos or watermarks.

en.title: Me Making Plans

## How to use

Upload one clear adult portrait. The demonstration reference is AI-generated. Keep all lettering in English.

## What to check

Inspect identity, layout and every requested caption at full size and at phone display size.
